clips.text: It happens to everyone. The question comes, and now you're flipping through tabs while the whole room waits.
MeetHint lives in your browser. You give it your world — code, contracts, lecture notes, curriculum, whatever you're gonna get asked about.
Can anyone tell me the three failure modes of the TCP handshake?
Connection refused, timeout, and reset. Page 12 of the lecture notes.
Actually — Amendment B, Section 3. Sixty days. March 15. Page 8.
Why does the retry logic cap at three?
The gateway stalls rather than failing fast. A fourth attempt duplicates the file. Line 4.
Can we also handle Stripe webhooks?
That's not in our current material. I'd need to check before I answer.
If it's not in your files, nothing is made up. The card stays empty. Cite or silence.
And when the meeting ends, you don't get a transcript. You get an audit. Every claim checked. Every contradiction flagged.
Turn on Listen, and it follows the call. Pop it on your second monitor. It only speaks when it can prove it.
Stop flipping. Stop guessing. Your files are the source of truth. The meeting just became searchable.
Join the waitlist — free during beta. MeetHint AI. Cite or silence.
